title: The massless sine-Gordon model with logarithmic correlations in arbitrary dimension
summary: In this article, we study the sine-Gordon model with logarithmic correlations in arbitrary dimension $d \ge 1$. The model is defined as a Euclidean field theory whose interaction term in the classical action is \[ S_{\mathrm{int}}(\varphi) := 2z \int_Λ \cos(\sqrtβ\,\varphi)\,\dx, \] where $\varphi$ is a logarithmically correlated Gaussian field on a compact domain $Λ\subset \mathbb{R}^d$ that coincides with the Gaussian free field when $d=2$, and where $z \in \mathbb{R}$ and $β>0$.
